items.text: Japan's oldest robot has been asked by its grandchildren to stop talking about the 2020s.
The Moon has started charging the tides for overtime.
A couple's AI assistants, who were planning the wedding, have married each other instead.
Continental drift has moved Australia two metres north, and Queensland wants to know who approved it.
A public servant has been promoted so many times without anyone noticing that he now runs the department, which has not noticed either.
The last petrol station in Sydney has been heritage-listed, and tourists queue to smell it.
